footnote_text: On October 9, 2026, the Reporting Person received the acquired securities in connection with the asset purchase transaction between SKK Holdings Ltd. ("Registrant") and Rantizo, Inc. pursuant to the Asset Purchase Agreement dated May 1, 2026 ("APA") and the Securities Purchase Agreement dated May 1, 2026 ("SPA") by and between the parties named therein. Pursuant to the APA, Rantizo, Inc. received Class A Ordinary Shares and other consideration pursuant to the APA and SPA for the sale of certain of its assets to the Registrant.
